title: Stateside postings and diesel mechanics school
summary: He served three years, sixteen months in the States around Florida, diesel school in Illinois, and departure for overseas.

story.theme_name: Drafted: musicians in the military and the war years
story.community_name: Drafted: service bands, USO shows and the war years

blocks.x: Oh, you did. How long did you stay in service?
Three years, too much. 22 days and five hours.
Yeah, exactly.
And I asked my company commander when there was the next bus leaving out for home.
Where were you stationed?
I stayed 16 months in the States.
Here in the States? Where?
I went to Mike Jimfield.
Where's that?
Down in Florida. All over Florida. Fort Myles, Sarasota, Tallahassee, Ole'Anna, St. Petersburg, Pensacola, Miami, then all over Florida. And then... Fort Chapel.
And then you went overseas?
Then I went from there to Dayton, Ohio. From there I went to Decent Mechanics School in the same hotel to Pure Illinois. I stayed there.
What did you learn there?

Decent Mechanics. I went to Decent Mechanics School at the Catterfield plant. From there they sent me back down to MacDill Field again. MacDill Field and sent me to Tallahassee, Florida. From there to Seattle, Washington at the Fort Emble location. Then we'll see.
Where'd you go? You went over to the Far East? To Japan?
Mm-hmm. Where'd you? Sicily, North Africa.
Oh, and you went out left from Seattle to go to Europe?
Yes, sir.
You went on a ship?
Ship. I went by plane.
Oh, you went by plane.
I caught a plane in Oklahoma.
Oh.
They rode me from Washington, D.C. to Oklahoma in one of them old cattle trucks. I caught a cattle truck.
